verdict.rationale: Vector quantization and compression is a fair question for a vector database, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no Chroma documentation of quantization, compression, or an accuracy trade-off. A community comment states that Weaviate has vector quantization, a feature Chroma does not (yet) have. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off
